claim: The United States consumed about 180 TWh of data-centre electricity in 2024, nearly 45% of the global total and more than 4% of all U.S. electricity consumption.
shortLabel: The U.S. hosts nearly 45% of global data-centre demand
displayValue: 180 TWh and nearly 45% of the global total
comparisonContext: This is why the U.S. experience can feel much more intense than the global averages suggest.
scopeNote: All U.S. data centres in 2024, not AI-only demand.
